findings.suggested_repair: Normalize markdown heading depth to the depth of the printed clause number across the whole file (9.x -> '##', 9.x.y -> '###', 9.x.y.z -> '####'); do not touch heading text. Because the artifact is document-wide, fix it with one mechanical pass rather than page by page.
